author: Charlotte Brontë
title: Jane Eyre: An Autobiography
edition: Project Gutenberg 1260 English transcription, whose title page identifies London: Service & Paton, 1897, illustrated by F. H. Townsend. Only the narrative text is used; illustrations and their duplicated alt-text captions are omitted. Plain-text underscore emphasis is retained. Prose line wrapping is joined with spaces; verse line and stanza breaks are preserved. The library text runs from the author's Preface and Note to the Third Edition through the end of Chapter XXXVIII; the title page, illustration notice and dedication are omitted.

rights.basis: The identified 1897 English edition was published before 1931 and its US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly marks this ebook public domain in the USA; no modern introduction or illustrations are reproduced.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pglaf mirror of ebook 1260). Removed the Gutenberg header, footer and licence and everything before the Preface; dropped the fourteen illustration captions that the plain text repeats as stand-alone lines (identified from the alt text of the same release's HTML file); joined wrapped prose lines with single spaces; kept verse and letter-closing lines as stanzas with their indentation; split the salutation of John Eyre's letter from its body; chapter and preface titles became headings. Underscore emphasis kept as printed in the file.
